RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: 40

An all-male panel can reflect systemic issues or unconscious bias, but panel composition alone does not prove discrimination. The selected candidate possessed distinct qualifications, such as international project leadership, which may have aligned with specific job requirements.

First, chase the outstanding written feedback to inspect the competency scores and interview notes. Check whether your civil service rules mandate balanced panels. If the ministry breached diversity rules or the scoring appears subjective and unsupported, you have a solid basis to raise procedural concerns through HR or a union representative. However, raising sex bias accusations before reviewing the formal scoring is premature.
